data.description: Drawbridge finding on PR #480: the Codex wrapper lifecycle test runs in no CI job, which is how its argv check rotted on main after the -c notify= prepend landed. Wire it (and peer wrapper tests in tests/test_*_wrapper*.py, if any) into ci.yml.
data.title: Run tests/test_codex_wrapper_resume.py in CI

provenance.reason: Added to c11 1.0 in the 2026-10-02 backlog review (Atin approved)

data.body:
Implementation at c75a4a7d77 includes current origin/main 61b4d6d94d (the intervening update was board-only). One branch covers C11-253 and C11-256; no push or PR yet.

Current baseline inventory is notes/c11-253-host-test-triage.md: 47 unique assertion-failing methods in hourly run 37044770017, including scraper crashes before the last runner summary (43 failures). Repairs, deletions and method-level environment quarantines are explicit. Seven historical C11-109 classes remain listed with C11-99 ownership. Real bugs repaired: browser append insertion index, and eight-digit theme literal alpha lost by magnitude-only inference.

Local lightweight checks passed: Codex resume, Codex completion, Claude/OpenCode/Pi runtime hooks, and 30 interactive-wrapper launch modes. Those six executable scripts now run in ordinary Ubuntu PR CI. No credentials, tenant writes or privileged triggers. Both workflow YAML files parse; diff whitespace check passes. Executing the actual host-step shell body with a synthetic build tool returned success for exit 0 and propagated exit 65; all 14 exclusions were printed and passed as skip arguments.

Native validation is still pending. Initial Atlas invocation 949e39312004431fade006ad39baa5ed uses tag c11-253 and an earlier c3dc4a8bc2 + hashed overlay snapshot, before the final product fixes; it is diagnostic only. Final committed-head retained-host proof follows it. No local native build, no laptop app launch, no release workflow, no independent review or runtime batch proof claimed.

C11-253 and C11-256 share branch c11-1.0/C11-253-ci-host-gate and one draft PR. Implementation: retained host tests now hard-fail ci-hourly.yml; its named quarantine prints seven historical C11-109 classes and six documented environment-dependent methods. The complete 47-method baseline inventory, dispositions and coverage limits are notes/c11-253-host-test-triage.md. A current-source Atlas diagnostic also exposed a stale built-bundle drag identifier, corrected without removing the test.

Real regressions repaired: Bonsplit browser append insertion index and leading-zero RGBA literal alpha. Other changes repair stale fixtures/expectations or delete 11 obsolete/timing-dependent methods per the brief. These deletions and quarantines do not establish real input, focus, leak, drag or tty behavior.

C11-256 wires six synthetic wrapper scripts into ordinary fork-safe Ubuntu PR CI: Codex resume, Codex hooks, Claude hooks, OpenCode hooks, Pi hooks, and all-wrapper interactive markers. All passed locally; the interactive script exercises 30 modes. No credentials, privileged triggers or tenant configuration writes.

Local checks: workflow YAML parses; git diff --check passes; executing the actual hourly host-step shell with a synthetic build returned 0 on success and propagated 65 on failure, printing/passing all 13 exclusions.

Final native gate: Atlas invocation 2ae3dcb7dac24210b3e6bc290a38a3eb, tag c11-253, clean committed head 34a59fead009690c3605140e4222fa4828d1166d after merging main dedc6007a5bb886388af23d7c48c48d76025772f. The source manifest has no overlay, matching pinned Ghostty 5830d1976eecca0d7dee202aef8fb2338d99ed6d and Bonsplit c17c6f41cd71066bda9bec82c54465fe34821c75. Compile and actual tests both pass: 1,573 retained host tests, zero failures, ** TEST SUCCEEDED **, 74.602 seconds of test execution. Xcode 26.3 (17C529), Zig 0.15.2. All 13 workflow exclusion identifiers match the test invocation.

Validation pointers in the lane worktree: build-remote/2ae3dcb7dac24210b3e6bc290a38a3eb/result.json and build-remote/2ae3dcb7dac24210b3e6bc290a38a3eb/build.log. The same invocation artifacts are on Atlas under ~/c11-builds/c11-253/artifacts/2ae3dcb7dac24210b3e6bc290a38a3eb/. Git whitespace checks and clean tree verified at this head. GitHub cheap checks run when the draft opens; their completion evidence follows separately.

Atlas run a88b939750cd4cb4a11487a32b1ea8d2 passed at clean d3683967f80b65adc53d8832eb0e5ddecf5c284c with 13 exclusions: 1,572 tests, zero failures, ** TEST SUCCEEDED **. This includes the corrected browser reveal test, built-bundle drag identifier, append ordering, RGBA regression table and golden snapshot. Main then advanced to dedc6007a5 (C11-265 attention order); merged without conflict as 34a59fead009690c3605140e4222fa4828d1166d and queued the exact-head host proof below.

Diagnostic Atlas run b7d6f724be01439188d57a62d069074b (clean c75a4a7d770232bb3cbf421a3b23fd71b32cc47a; 14 exclusions) executed 1,571 tests with one failure, the stale drag UTType assertion already corrected in the final head. Append ordering, literal alpha and golden snapshot tests passed. Earlier run 949e39312004431fade006ad39baa5ed used a partial implementation overlay and is diagnostic only. Neither diagnostic is the final gate.

Validator scenario (packaged-app batch on Atlas, still pending):
1. On merged main run CI hourly. Expect retained host tests succeed; any retained assertion failure fails the job, and all 13 exclusions are printed. Run ordinary Ubuntu PR CI and verify all six wrapper scripts execute.
2. In an isolated tagged Atlas app, create two tabs in one area then open a browser using the append-at-end keyboard path. Expect the browser to appear last while existing tabs retain order.
3. Load a theme containing #00000000 and #00112280. Expect transparent black alpha 0 and RGB 0/17/34 with alpha 128/255; six-digit #000000 stays opaque.
4. In a tagged isolated Atlas guest, exercise Shift+backquote, Option+Delete and Korean IME commit plus Return. Expect literal tilde, word deletion and one command submission; exercise split-click/first-responder recovery and expect active split and responder to converge. The synthetic host exclusions do not prove these scenarios.
5. Drive browser hide/reveal and transient area rebind. Expect repaint without ordinary-visibility page reload and preserved presentation during bounded anchor recovery.

No packaged-app runtime proof or independent review is claimed here. No release workflow was triggered; owner does not merge. The Orchestrator routes review and the Merge Captain owns landing at the reviewed head.

PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/552 remains draft and unmerged at 34a59fead009690c3605140e4222fa4828d1166d. Combined C11-253/C11-256 HANDOFF REVIEW was delivered to Orchestrator tab:210; both tickets are in review.

Exact-head cheap CI completed green: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/actions/runs/37054627011 . Workflow guards (35s), remote daemon tests (36s), and web typecheck (55s) passed. The Validate agent wrapper lifecycle and resume step succeeded, executing all six scripts on Ubuntu. Python syntax also passed (run 37054612786). Drawbridge draft-only stages were skipped; those skips are not independent-review or merge proof.

The native gate remains Atlas run 2ae3dcb7dac24210b3e6bc290a38a3eb: 1,573 retained host tests with zero failures at the same head. Native/source/fixture triage and numbered packaged-app Validator scenarios are in the preceding validation comment. Independent review, packaged-app batch validation and landing remain pending with the Orchestrator/Merge Captain. No owner merge or release.
